risk_note: RV2 by path (catalog infra). FU-DETAIL-CACHE-IMAGES: the product cache (catalog/infra/product-cache.ts) now stores the five card fields it dropped: shop_name, category_l1_id, category_l1_name, main_image_url, image_urls. Present values are stored and read back unchanged (image_urls a string array, order and repeats kept); absent ones are not written and not read back; a field of the wrong type makes the entry unreadable, which the existing read path treats as a miss and refetches. Old entries without these fields read as before. TTL, hit and stale rules, and the public-data-only scope are unchanged. No amount, no migration, no contract change.
